title: 第15章 血债血偿第16章 雷神灭世
slug: 惊天剑帝第7906章空气太敏感
content_zh:
林白顺着河流往下走了很久，终于来到一片沼泽里。
抬头一看，沼泽里正好有一只黑铁色的犀牛饮水。
“黑甲神角犀！”林白咧嘴一笑。
这头犀牛，就是林白这次的目标，一尊武道九重巅峰的妖兽。
这一段时间以来，自从加入斩妖盟，得到了地图上的坐标，林白疯狂的猎杀了十几头的妖兽，炼血化精后，将自己的武道修为提升到了武道八重。
“不知道这头犀牛能不能让我踏破武道九重的大关！”
“有了武道九重的力量，回到灵犀城，才更有资本去和林紫儿一战！”
林白望着饮水的黑甲神角犀，忽然间，林白神色如常的脸色变成了凶神恶煞。
铮！
斩灵剑出窍，杀意暴露！
专心饮水的黑甲神角犀察觉到了杀意，仰起头来，看见了在岸边一直注视着它的林白。
从这个人类的身上，黑甲神角犀感觉到了杀意！
哞！
黑甲神角犀怒吼一声，铁蹄践踏地面，对准林白冲撞过来，每当他落下铁蹄，都会震得沼泽颤抖几下。
这头黑甲神角犀的吨位，恐怕不亚于三吨之重。
尤其是他的独角，闪烁着令人心悸的寒光，似要刺破苍穹一般！
嘭的一声，黑甲神角犀冲撞过来，林白老练的闪烁避开，一跃天空之上，斩灵剑凶狠的斩出几道剑光，击中黑甲神角犀的后背上。
可是，这黑甲神角犀除了他的独角厉害之外，他身上的黑甲，也是格外的恐怖。
纵然林白武道八重的修为，斩出的剑光，也无法伤害到他的皮毛！
“居然有这么厉害的防御，好吧，一剑飙血！”

林白动用武技，剑势顿时凶猛起来。
血色剑光击中，让黑甲神角犀凄厉的惨叫了一声，双蹄猛然一塔地面，震起沼泽中的一道血流席卷而来，将林白困在其中。
“控水的力量？”
林白惊骇了一下。
被一个巨大的水球包裹起来，那黑甲神角犀顿时怒撞过来。
林白若是待在水球之中，必定会被黑甲神角犀撞得四分五裂！
“雷神剑！”
咔咔一声惊雷破空，一道电光席卷，将水球击碎，正巧让林白看见了袭击而来的黑甲神角犀。
“冷血一剑！”
血色剑光从黑甲神角犀的独角上一闪而逝。
啪！
黑甲神角犀的独角被林白一剑斩落下来，剑光直径洞穿了它的头颅。
庞大的黑甲神角犀倒在地上，砸出一个巨大的深坑。
“能不能突破武道九重，就看现在了！”
林白目光专注的走了过去，坐在独角神角犀的身边，吞噬剑魂炼化妖血疯狂的注入林白的体内，让林白的境界再次往前迈进了一大步。
可是，始终没有踏破武道九重的大关。
“还差一点点吗？可是我已经没有时间了呀。”林白摇头道。
content_en:
Lin Bai walked down the river for a long time and finally came to a swamp.
Looking up, I saw a black iron-colored rhinoceros drinking water in the swamp.
"Black-armored Divine Horned Rhinoceros!" Lin Bai grinned.
This rhinoceros was Lin Bai's target this time, a monster beast at the ninth level of martial arts.
During this period of time, since he joined the Demon Slayer Alliance and obtained the coordinates on the map, Lin Bai frantically hunted more than a dozen demonic beasts. After refining blood and essence, he upgraded his martial arts cultivation to the eighth level of martial arts.
"I wonder if this rhinoceros can help me break through the ninth level of martial arts!"
"With the power of the ninth level of martial arts, when we return to Lingxi City, we will have more capital to fight Lin Zi'er!"
Lin Bai looked at the black-armored rhinoceros drinking water. Suddenly, Lin Bai's normal expression turned into a fierce one.
Zheng!
The spirit-cutting sword comes out of the body, and the murderous intention is revealed!
The black-armored rhinoceros, which was concentrating on drinking water, sensed murderous intent, raised its head, and saw Lin Bai, who had been watching it from the shore.
From this human being, the Black-armored Divine Horned Rhino sensed murderous intent!
Moo!
The black-armored horned rhinoceros roared angrily, trampled the ground with its iron hoofs, and charged towards Lin Bai. Every time he dropped his iron hoofs, the swamp would tremble.
The tonnage of this black-armored divine horned rhinoceros is probably no less than three tons.
Especially his horn, which shone with a heart-stopping cold light, as if it was about to pierce the sky!
With a bang, the black-armored divine horned rhinoceros rushed towards him. Lin Bai avoided it with a practiced flick, leaped into the sky, and fiercely slashed out several rays of sword light with the spirit-slaying sword, hitting the black-armored divine horned rhinoceros on the back.
However, in addition to the powerful one horn of this black-armored rhinoceros, the black armor on his body is also particularly terrifying.
Even though Lin Bai was at the eighth level of martial arts, his sword light couldn't hurt his fur!
"You actually have such a powerful defense, well, you can draw blood with just one sword!"
Lin Bai used his martial arts skills, and his sword suddenly became fierce.
The bloody sword light struck, causing the Black-armored Divine Horned Rhinoceros to scream miserably. His hoofs suddenly hit the ground, causing a stream of blood to sweep through the swamp, trapping Lin Bai in it.
"The power to control water?"
Lin Bai was shocked.
Wrapped in a huge water ball, the black-armored horned rhinoceros suddenly rushed towards him angrily.
If Lin Bai stayed in the water polo, he would definitely be knocked to pieces by the black-armored horned rhinoceros!
"Thunder Sword!"
A crack of thunder broke through the air, and a bolt of lightning swept across, smashing the water ball into pieces. Lin Bai happened to see the attacking black-armored rhinoceros.
"A cold-blooded sword!"
The bloody sword light flashed from the horn of the black-armored rhinoceros.
Snap!
The single horn of the black-armored rhinoceros was cut off by Lin Bai's sword, and the light of the sword pierced its head.
The huge black-armored horned rhinoceros fell to the ground, creating a huge deep pit.
"Whether you can break through the ninth level of martial arts depends on now!"
Lin Bai walked over with focused eyes, sat next to the One-Horned God Rhinoceros, swallowed the sword soul, refined the demon blood and injected it crazily into Lin Bai's body, making Lin Bai's realm take a big step forward again.
However, he has never reached the ninth level of martial arts.
"Is it still a little bit close? But I don't have time anymore." Lin Bai shook his head.
